title: Qwen3.8-27B speculative decoding on a single RTX 3090
description:
A preregistered, paired and interleaved benchmark of llama.cpp's draft-mtp and draft-dflash speculative decoding on one RTX 3090, with the hypotheses and the analysis plan committed before Phase A data collection.

The deposit ships the per-request measurement records, the analysis harness that produced every reported figure, and a dated log of every correction and withdrawal — including the hypotheses the data did not support and the claims that were retracted after they had been published. Arms are interleaved within each pass and every arm is gated on the card's own temperature before it starts, because across one pass this card climbs from 62 C to 84 C and sheds roughly 9 % of its SM clock, which is larger than several of the effects being resolved.
